milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the pink concrete powder block (placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 8], at ground level beside the oak hut) and face toward it, confirming they have located and can see the block. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to visually identify the block, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than facing away. Target is at y=0 (ground level) because pink concrete powder is gravity-affected and falls to the surface — confirmed via sandbox gravity test.
